examples.en: You're about to run off with her entire family, and we haven't even laid eyes on this Bai Xiaohe!
examples.zh: 都要跟人家全家跑了，我们还没见过白晓荷这个人呢！

examples.en: You always took the others lightly—only this time it's different. What if everyone before was just a good match, and only with Bai Xiaohe is it your heart speaking?
examples.zh: 你之前都轻描淡写的，就只有这一次。有没有可能，你之前遇到的那些，就是合适、匹配；只有跟白晓荷，是心意。

tags: 化学女博士，黄振华相亲对象（前期）
